requirements: Keep records earned in earlier seasons when another season starts or later records are logged.
Show the season's initials with silver trophies in Home, Log, and History.
Place initials to the left of the trophy and align gold and silver trophy icons.
Accept optional initials when creating a season. Otherwise concatenate uppercase first characters of whitespace-separated name words.
Generate initials for existing seasons and preserve custom initials in full backups.
Use season start dates without adding special same-day handling, as requested.
Preserve the user's workout and measurement data through emulator testing.

emulator_checks: Every original database table and value survived migration from schema 8 to 9.
Existing season name Let's GO automatically displays LG without changing stored season data.
Created Winter Build with custom initials WB26 and a 1 September start date through Settings.
Created Autumn Strength with initials omitted and a 1 October start date. AS is derived from its name.
The September 80 kg and 85 kg records retained WB26 trophies after October records gained AS trophies.
The older 100 kg and newer 110 kg all-time records both retain gold trophies.
Verified season badges in History and the old workout Log. Final release Home and Settings show initials to the left with trophy icons aligned.
Final release shows AS as a visible default before the initials field is focused. Cancel closes the preview without saving another season.
